data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 30,830,000 (2021: surplus of GBP 16,021,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. Prior year reserve releases on the 2019 and prior years of account contributed GBP 27.6 million to underwriting profit (2021: GBP 17.3 million), predominantly across the Property & Motor division.

The Syndicate has potential losses due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine, stemming from its Political Risks, Political Violence, Contract Frustration, Marine Excess of Loss and Aviation classes; management's reserving approach supports the held reserves at the year-end date.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 375.528m. Analysis of the claims development table indicates a net favourable movement on prior underwriting years (<=2020) of approximately GBP 19.3m (a release). The report also notes prior year reserve releases on 2019 and earlier contributing GBP 27.6m to underwriting profit (predominantly across Property & Motor). The release is attributed to favourable claims development on older years, while 2022 had elevated current-year catastrophe-related claims from Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot, Sydney Floods and provisions for exposures arising from the Russia/Ukraine conflict.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not provided as a single gross movement figure in the movement note; gross PYD was derived from the published GROSS claims development table (claims triangle) on page 33 using the required diagonal comparison and excluding the two most recent underwriting years. The report also quotes net prior-year reassessment amounts (e.g. GBP 30.83m net) and a net prior-year reserve release figure of GBP 27.6m for 2019 & prior; these net figures were NOT used as the primary PYD figure. The triangle interpretation assumes the last non-null value in each UW column is the 'current estimate' and that parenthesized trailing numbers are 'claims paid' figures; if the publisher's formatting differs the PYD calculation may vary.
